items.title: Record-Breaking 15 Tbps DDoS Attack From 500,000+ Devices Hits Azure Network
items.description: Microsoft Azure thwarted what may be the largest distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack ever recorded in the cloud on October 24. The attack peaked at 15.72 terabits per second (Tbps) and unleashed nearly 3.64 billion packets per second (pps), targeting a single endpoint in Australia.
